svg.text: D06 · F3 PREPARE THE RIVAL (A1 LOADING)
Briefing: the rival is preparing (states 1-2 of 5: initial and loading)

text.tspan: A1 loading: the model reads recent attempts and chooses a
strategy (about 15 s on a CPU laptop)
Says what the model is doing ("is studying you"), names the
model, says whether it is a first meeting, and counts the
Cancel preparation: the player is never stuck waiting.

The objective and controls can be read while the model
works, so the wait is useful.
